# MiniMe Atlas — The Connected Ecosystem Book (14 Guides + Full Codebase Index)

Static, offline-capable engineering atlas and 14-chapter connected book for the MiniMe AI ecosystem (MiniMe Web, M2C L26 (Minime to Code) Terminal/Editor Agent, Menux (Minime agentic automation) Personal Automation Agent, and FBEBC Research).

## Start here
- Human overview & ecosystem sync map: index.html
- Complete 14-chapter connected book library: docs.html
- Cross-book consistency & reconciliation matrix: consistency.html
- Master timeline & critical path (plan vs actual): roadmap.html
- Machine-readable executive summary: data/summary.md

## The 14 Connected Book Chapters (Markdown Sources in `data/docs/` & `docs/`, HTML Readers at `doc-*.html`)

### Part I — Strategy, Governance & Master Sequence
1. Financial & Model Strategy Rulebook (`data/docs/MiniMe_Financial_Strategy_Rulebook.md` -> `doc-rulebook.html`) — The constitution: 15 golden rules, 4 tiers (Free $0, Basic $9, Moderate $29, Ultimate $79), COGS-at-cap <= 45%, 8 LLM providers, hiring & funding gates.
2. Technical Implementation Roadmap (`data/docs/minime_technical_roadmap.md` -> `doc-tech-roadmap.html`) — Tech-A to Tech-H sequence, shared `usage_ledger` (`0012`), model hygiene, and ecosystem timeline integration.
3. Server Management & Splitting Guide (`data/docs/minime_server_management_guide.md` -> `doc-server-guide.html`) — Metric-gated infrastructure evolution from Stage 1 single VPS ($14/mo) to Stage 5 full split, plus local-first footprint of M2C & Menux.

### Part II — MiniMe Core Flagship (Web Workspace)
4. MiniMe — Complete Feature & Product Guide (`data/docs/minime_feature_guide.md` -> `doc-minime-feature-guide.html`) — All 25 subsystems, 25-stage orchestrator, 73 agent modules (46 router roles), 6-tier memory, knowledge graph, mechanical CAD engine, and S0->S3b evolution.

### Part III — M2C L26 · Minime to Code (Local-First Terminal & Editor Coding Agent)
5. M2C L26 — Complete Feature & Product Guide (`data/docs/m2c_feature_guide.md` -> `doc-m2c-feature-guide.html`) — Local CLI (`m2c`), TUI, the 11-tool catalog in the code today, policy modes, OS sandbox, git checkpoints, headless `-p`, and a prior-art and ideas section (revision 1.2: commands and tools now match the code; status marked built or planned).
6. M2C L26 — Build Execution Guide (`data/docs/m2c_build_plan.md` -> `doc-m2c-plan.html`) — 69 patch-sized work packages across 12 waves for Phases 0-4 (163 effort points; Phase 5 adds 7 more), Phase 0 browser cut (`B00-B12`), Overrides O1-O8, a build status snapshot (§0.6), decisions D13-D18, and the new C25, Q07, Q08, Q09, C28 and C27 packages (revision 1.2).
7. M2C L26 — Original Product & Design Spec (`guides/M2C___Product___Build_Guide.html` -> `doc-m2c-product.html`) — Initial product spec (superseded on topology/billing by Overrides O1-O8).

### Part IV — Menux · Minime agentic automation (Local-First Personal Automation Agent)
8. Menux — Complete Feature & Product Guide (`data/docs/menux_feature_guide.md` -> `doc-menux-feature-guide.html`) — Local-first personal automation daemon (`menux`), Run Engine, 4-tier Approval Manager, 6 messaging channels, 9 connectors, Playwright browser automation, and Argon2id + AES-256-GCM vault. Revision 1.1 adds the planned Companion Expansion (Reach 0-4, control ladder, virtual desktop, screen memory, skill templates; Sections 17-27, gated on Phase 4). Revision 1.2 adds the planned device mesh (Sections 28-37: link phones, browsers, chat apps and other computers to the account; node-approved pairing; signed, end-to-end encrypted remote control and approvals with controller classes; sync spaces; leases and failover; Windows and macOS satellites on agent-desktop), gated on Phase 4.
9. Menux — Build Execution Guide (`data/docs/Menux___Build_Execution_Guide.md` -> `doc-menux-plan.html`) — 59 patch-sized work packages across 16 waves (133 effort points), local-first Overrides O1-O8. Revision 1.1 rewrites Phase 5 as 5A/5B/5C (45 WPs, about 133 points) with extensions CX1-CX7 and decisions D15-D25; Phases 0-4 unchanged. Revision 1.2 adds Phase 5R (remote control and the device mesh, 17 WPs, 49 pts) and Phase 5P (platforms and satellites, 7 WPs, 22 pts), extensions MX1-MX9 and decisions D26-D38, and replaces the Windows-side helper (D07/D08) with the Windows satellite P03; Phase 5 is now 68 WPs and about 204 pts.
10. Menux — Original Product & Design Spec (`guides/Menux___Product___Build_Guide.html` -> `doc-menux-product.html`) — Initial product spec (superseded on topology/billing by Overrides O1-O8).

### Part V — FBEBC Research Program (Fitness-Band Elitist Bacterial Colony)
11. FBEBC — Research Program Guide (`data/docs/fbebc-research-program-guide.md` -> `doc-fbebc-program.html`) — Stage 1 zero-cost preprint to Stage 2 MiniMe-integrated evolution engine (`backend/agents/evolution/`).
12. FBEBC — Phase 1 Implementation Guide (`data/docs/fbebc-phase1-implementation-guide.md` -> `doc-fbebc-phase1.html`) — Immutable barrier (`fbebc/barrier.py`) and 5-component package spec.
13. FBEBC — Preprint / Workshop Paper Guide (`data/docs/fbebc-preprint-workshop-paper-guide.md` -> `doc-fbebc-paper.html`) — Claim ladder (C0-C3), figures, stats recipes, and submission checklist.
14. FBEBC — Live Build & Run Status (`data/docs/STATUS.md` -> `doc-fbebc-status.html`) — 89 passing tests, 4 bug fixes (D1-D4), and live FunSearch run log.

## Appendix (not one of the 14 chapters)
A. Migration Guide: Rust, TypeScript and a Hardened Python Backend (`data/docs/migration_guide.md` -> `doc-migration-guide.html`) — 42 patch-sized work packages (114 effort points, 9 dependency waves) to move the M2C client and Menux to Rust, the frontend to TypeScript, keep and harden the Python backend, and retire the old `daemon/`; the protocol schemas, golden fixtures and new conformance vectors are the shared contract across languages.

## Interactive Atlas Pages
- `roadmap.html` — Master timeline (plan vs actual) + 5-swimlane dependency & gate map
- `todo.html` — Shared team Kanban, List, Calendar, Timeline & Activity log
- `journey.html` — Interactive section-by-section reading & build tracker across all 14 guides
- `progress.html` — Tech-A through Tech-H matched against real codebase files
- `build.html` — Interactive work-package tracker for M2C (64 WPs), Menux (59 WPs), and FBEBC
- `decisions.html` — 86 golden rules, roadmap gates, and pre-patch architectural decisions
- `consistency.html` — Cross-book governance & reconciliation matrix
- `explore.html`, `map.html`, `code.html`, `functions.html`, `graph.html`, `api.html`, `agents.html`, `data.html`, `infra.html`, `history.html`, `architecture.html`, `tests.html`, `health.html`, `finance.html`, `rulebook.html`, `tables.html`
- `protocol.html`, `m2c.html`, `adrs.html` — The M2C wire contract (message types, fields, tools, risk levels, real examples), the device client's package map and commands, and MiniMe's architecture decision records; all drawn from `data/code/protocol.json`
